$f_m$: \ a small tree that walks downhill on the loss
\sum_i \ell(y_i, F_i + f_i) + \Omega(f) \;\approx\; \sum_i \big[\ell_i + g_i f_i + \tfrac12 h_i f_i^2\big] + \gamma T + \tfrac12\lambda\sum_j w_j^2
